messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Elevated 5xx and gateway timeouts observed for /v1/generate. Auto-paging on-call.
alex.k: I'm seeing a sudden spike in 502/504s from api-gateway starting ~07:13 UTC. Alert rate ~480/min. kv-prefix cache eviction metrics are off the charts.
chris.sre: on it. any direct customer reports?
maria.cs: 2 tickets from EU customers reporting timeouts and "generation failed" errors. Not yet widespread but correlated timing.
alex.k: quick glance at storage IOPS looks fine. kv-prefix-cache shows eviction burst and "checksum_mismatch" counters incrementing.
incident-bot: Triggered alerts: api-5xx-rate > 200/m, kv-prefix-eviction-rate > 1000/s, kv-prefix-checksum-mismatch > 5/min
alex.k: stack traces: `prefix_checksum_mismatch shard=12 prefix=0x7a4c` leading to upstream 502. Logs: ```[2026-03-15T07:14:02Z] ERROR kvcache shard=12 lookup failed checksum expected=0x5a3ef got=0x2b9d3
[2026-03-15T07:14:02Z] WARN router route=api-prod backend=kv-cache shard=12 fallback=miss
[2026-03-15T07:14:02Z] ERROR http gateway service=gen status=502 cause=kv-cache-read-failure```
chris.sre: any recent changes to eviction or rebalancer?
alex.k: there was a config push ~05:10 UTC that adjusted LRU threshold to 0.6 and a minor rebalancer tweak (PR-4892). That overlaps incident start.
oncall-handoff-bot: paging escalation to night oncall chris.sre (30m). alex.k handing off.
alex.k: handing off. collected heap/core dumps at /tmp/dumps/incident-1890123456.tgz and enabled verbose kvcache logging.
chris.sre: mitigation options: (A) disable checksum validation on reads for affected shards (fast but risky), (B) bypass prefix cache for impacted shards forcing origin reads (safer but adds latency). Thoughts?
alex.k: disabling checksum may allow corrupt payloads through. Prefer bypassing cache to force misses - increases latency but prevents 502s.
maria.ops: prepping customer notice if incident >30m.
chris.sre: applying bypass for shard range 10-14 and non-critical models, open fallback pool to handle elevated origin load. Executing: ```bash
curl -X POST "https://controlplane.internal/configs/kv-cache/bypass" -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ADMIN_TOKEN}" -d '{"shards": [10,11,12,13,14], "bypass": true, "reason": "inc-1890123456"}'
```
incident-bot: CONFIG CHANGE: kv-prefix-bypass applied to 5 shards (inc-1890123456).
alex.k: immediate improvement: shard-12 logs stop producing checksum errors; 5xx rate fell from ~480/min to ~60/min within 4 minutes. Timeouts reduced.
maria.cs: sent customer note draft: "We've routed around the affected cache to mitigate errors. Investigating root cause and will follow up." Sending now.
marc.eng: initiating rollback of LRU tuning PR-4892 to remove the rebalancer change that may have triggered the compaction race. Can we rollback safely?
alex.k: rollback is config-only across cache fleet. Recommend keeping bypass in place while we revert then validate integrity before re-enabling cache.
chris.sre: agreed. rolling back PR-4892: canary -> staging -> prod.
incident-bot: ROLLBACK: PR-4892 rollback started at 07:34 UTC.
chris.sre: prod rollback completed 07:45 UTC. Monitoring metrics.
alex.k: post-rollback + bypass, 5xx settled to ~35/min (baseline ~20). Keeping bypass until we run full integrity sweep.
alex.k: kicking off integrity scan: `kv-cache-scan --shards=0-255 --checksum-verify --report=/tmp/scan-1890123456.json`
alex.k: initial scan: 12 checksum mismatches found clustered in shards 10-14. Likely compaction/eviction race produced corrupted entries during rebalancer movement.
chris.sre: that matches symptoms: concurrent compaction + eviction could create transient corrupt entries. We'll add a compaction guard in rebalancer code.
maria.cs: customer impact summary: approx 14 customers experienced transient 502s, 3 opened support tickets (A-Corp, B-Software, C-Platform). No persisted data loss, client retries recovered requests.
marc.eng: follow-ups: ACTION-1 full integrity repair of affected shards (ETA 3h), ACTION-2 PR adding atomic compaction guard + tests, ACTION-3 tighten canary gating for eviction tuning.
alex.k: creating repair run now: `kv-cache-repair --shards=10-14 --repair-mode=rehash --backup=/backups/pre-repair-1890123456`
chris.sre: set monitoring watch for 2h. oncall handing back to rotation. incident-bot: INCIDENT MITIGATED at 08:02 UTC. Keep monitoring for regressions.
maria.ops: posting customer update and scheduling postmortem.
alex.k: notes: mitigation used bypass to avoid 5xxs; rollback restored previous behavior; root cause most likely compaction/eviction race introduced by rebalancer change.
chris.sre: postmortem owner = chris.sre, reviewers = alex.k, marc.eng, maria.ops. Target draft within 48h. Closing thread when postmortem created. Thanks all. :heart:
